case_number: WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 724 OF 2023; WITH WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 705 OF 2023; WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 764 OF 2023
summary: EWS reservation eligibility; interpretation of OM 19.01.2019/31.01.2019 and CSE-2022 Rules 13,27,28; crucial date for I&AC submission as closing date of application; mandatory possession of income/asset certificate for FY 2020-21; pandemic delays insufficient excuse for non-compliance; UPSC's denial justified; strict adherence required for reservation claims.
legal_provisions_cited: Civil Services Examination Rules, 2022 r.13, r.27, r.28
final_judgment: Writ petitions dismissed; UPSC's denial of EWS benefit upheld; no relaxation for pandemic-related delays in certificate submission.
